subtitle.zh: 我们不是选股，而是把 AI 基建拆成一条有分工的价值链。
subtitle.en: We are not picking stocks; we are decomposing AI infrastructure into a value chain with distinct jobs.

mapIntro.zh: 每个层级回答一个不同的问题：需求在哪里出现、瓶颈在哪里形成、哪篇报告负责验证或证伪这条链。
mapIntro.en: Each layer answers a different question: where demand appears, where bottlenecks form, and which report validates or falsifies the chain.

otherIntro.zh: 这些报告暂不承担 AI 基建链条验证角色，保留在完整研究覆盖中。
otherIntro.en: These reports do not currently carry an AI-infrastructure chain-validation role, but remain part of the broader research coverage.

disclaimer.zh: 免责声明：本页仅用于研究框架展示和信息交流，不构成任何投资建议，请自行完成尽职调查。
disclaimer.en: Disclaimer: This page is for research-framework display and information exchange only. It does not constitute investment advice. Please conduct your own due diligence.

description.zh: 光刻、沉积、刻蚀、过程控制与先进封装设备，用来检验 AI 资本开支是否真正进入工具订单和交付瓶颈。
description.en: Lithography, deposition, etch, process control, and advanced-packaging tools test whether AI capex is truly entering equipment orders and delivery bottlenecks.

description.zh: 设计自动化、验证、仿真与半导体 IP，用来验证架构复杂度、AI 芯片设计启动和先进节点迁移。
description.en: Design automation, verification, simulation, and semiconductor IP validate architecture complexity, AI chip design starts, and advanced-node migration.

description.zh: 先进制程晶圆制造与代工产能分配，用来检验 AI 逻辑芯片的供给上限、先进节点定价权，以及 CoWoS 排产是否由单一制造方决定。
description.en: Leading-edge wafer manufacturing and foundry capacity allocation test the supply ceiling for AI logic, advanced-node pricing power, and whether CoWoS scheduling is set by a single manufacturer.

description.zh: OSAT、封装产能、基板与 HBM 集成，用来检验 AI 先进封装是绑定在晶圆代工厂内部随晶圆定价，还是第三方能持有可独立定价的持久份额。
description.en: OSAT, packaging capacity, substrates, and HBM integration test whether AI advanced packaging stays bundled inside the foundry and priced with the wafer, or a third party can hold durable, independently-priceable share.

description.zh: GPU、加速卡和系统平台，是 AI 资本开支叙事的收入与利润核心。
description.en: GPUs, accelerators, and system platforms - the revenue and profit core of the AI capex narrative.

description.zh: ASIC、XPU 与 merchant silicon，用来检验 hyperscaler 自研和开放生态对通用 GPU 的替代强度。
description.en: ASICs, XPUs, and merchant silicon that test hyperscaler in-house silicon and open-ecosystem substitution against general GPUs.

description.zh: HBM、NAND、近线 HDD 与数据中心 SSD，负责验证 AI 工作负载是否真的转化为位元、带宽和周期利润。
description.en: HBM, NAND, nearline HDDs, and data-center SSDs validate whether AI workloads convert into bits, bandwidth, and cycle profits.

description.zh: 以太网、交换系统和网络软件，校验 AI 集群架构路线，而不只是算力芯片出货。
description.en: Ethernet, switching systems, and network software validate AI cluster architecture, not just accelerator shipments.

description.zh: PCIe/CXL retimer、信号完整性与机架内外互连，检验 GPU 集群 fan-out 是否形成区别于以太网与光模块的独立约束。
description.en: PCIe/CXL retimers, signal integrity, and rack-scale interconnect test whether GPU-cluster fan-out creates a constraint distinct from Ethernet and optical links.

description.zh: 有源光模块、光纤、光缆和被动连接材料，观察 AI 集群扩容是否穿透到物理连接层。
description.en: Active modules, fiber, cable, and passive connectivity materials show whether AI cluster expansion reaches the physical link layer.

description.zh: 燃气轮机、电网、燃料电池、核能、电力设备和储能，是 AI 数据中心最硬的外部约束。
description.en: Gas turbines, grid equipment, fuel cells, nuclear, electrical equipment, and storage are the hard external constraints for AI data centers.

description.zh: 托管租赁、互联与机柜产能，加上电力管理、UPS、热管理和液冷，共同检验建设速度、网络密度与机柜功率密度。
description.en: Colocation leasing, interconnection, and cabinet capacity, together with power management, UPS, thermal management, and liquid cooling, test buildout speed, network density, and rack power density.

description.zh: 铜、钨等关键资源层，用于约束电网、设备、国防与制造链条的上游可得性。
description.en: Copper, tungsten, and other critical resources constrain upstream availability for grids, equipment, defense, and manufacturing.

description.zh: 用高杠杆 GPU 云、客户集中度和基础模型应用变现检验需求是否真实，而不是由融资、循环交易、补贴流量和提前囤货放大。
description.en: Uses leveraged GPU cloud, customer concentration, and foundation-model application monetization to test whether demand is real, rather than amplified by financing, circularity, subsidized traffic, and pre-stocking.

description.zh: 最实时地观察 AI 建设速度和订单质量。
description.en: Tracks AI buildout velocity and order quality in near real time.

description.zh: 若该报告被证伪，整条 AI 基建书都必须重新校准。
description.en: If this report is falsified, the whole AI-infra book must be recalibrated.

description.zh: 验证不同技术路线之间的真实采用强度。
description.en: Tests real adoption strength across competing architecture paths.

description.zh: 横跨多个层级的瓶颈或共同约束变量。
description.en: A bottleneck or shared constraint that cuts across multiple layers.

label.zh: 近线 HDD：为存储层补上区别于 NAND 的供给曲线，与 sandisk-2026 同源反向配对
label.en: Nearline HDD: adds a supply curve distinct from NAND, pairing with sandisk-2026 as its former parent and opposite medium

label.zh: 有源电缆与硅光：为 alab-2026 的架构问题补上缺失的对手方，并延伸至光连接层
label.en: Active electrical cables and silicon photonics: gives the alab-2026 architecture question its missing counterparty, and reaches into the optical layer

label.zh: 先进封装设备首选代理：用可计数的 TCB/HB 工具订单、出货与验收，检验 OSAT 扩产意图是否转成合格产能；设备订单不等于 CoWoS 产出
label.en: First advanced-packaging equipment proxy: use countable TCB/HB tool orders, shipments, and acceptance to test whether OSAT capacity intent becomes qualified capacity; tool orders are not CoWoS output

label.zh: 混合键合转产代理：检验逻辑与 HBM 客户是否从评估工具转向重复量产订单，作为 ASMPT 之后的工艺迁移交叉验证
label.en: Hybrid-bonding production proxy: tests whether logic and HBM customers move from evaluation tools to repeat production orders, cross-checking the process transition after ASMPT

if.zh: 如果 GPU/ASIC 收入继续加速，但网络、光连接和设施订单没有同步确认
if.en: If GPU/ASIC revenue keeps accelerating but networking, optical, and facility orders do not confirm it

then.zh: 则优先怀疑提前囤货、客户集中或节奏错配，而不是直接上调长期需求。
then.en: then first suspect pre-stocking, customer concentration, or timing mismatch before lifting long-term demand assumptions.

if.zh: 如果 Vertiv、GE Vernova 或 Bloom 的订单/积压开始降温
if.en: If orders or backlog at Vertiv, GE Vernova, or Bloom begin to cool

then.zh: 则 AI 数据中心建设速度可能低于芯片端叙事，需要下调交付节奏。反向推断要同样谨慎：超大规模厂商 capex 金额上升本身并不构成订单量信号 —— capex 金额可能由投入品价格推高（2026 年的例子是内存）而非由台数推高，因此在据此推断供应商订单前，需先剔除投入品价格上涨的影响。
then.en: then AI data-center buildout speed may lag the chip-side narrative, and delivery cadence should be marked down. Read the reverse inference with the same caution: a rising hyperscaler capex figure is not by itself an order-volume signal, because capex dollars can rise on input prices — memory in the 2026 case — rather than on units, so deflate the dollar guide for input-price inflation before inferring supplier orders.

if.zh: 如果核电 PPA 继续变强，但燃气容量、C&I VPP、ERCOT/PJM 容量价格或零售电力利润率没有同步确认
if.en: If nuclear PPAs keep strengthening but gas capacity, C&I VPPs, ERCOT/PJM capacity prices, or retail power margins do not confirm

then.zh: 则 AI 电力约束应被视为更窄的清洁 baseload 叙事，而不是全电力系统的 merchant capacity 重估。
then.en: then treat the AI power constraint as a narrower clean-baseload story, not a full-system merchant-capacity repricing.

if.zh: 如果 Broadcom 的自定义硅与 Arista 的开放以太网生态同时变强
if.en: If Broadcom custom silicon and Arista's open Ethernet ecosystem strengthen together

then.zh: 则 NVIDIA 一体化栈的增速和利润率需要接受更严格的架构压力测试。
then.en: then NVIDIA's integrated-stack growth and margin assumptions need a stricter architecture stress test.

if.zh: 如果 HBM/NAND 利润率达到周期高位，但终端 AI 需求确认不足
if.en: If HBM/NAND margins hit cyclical highs without enough end-demand confirmation

then.zh: 则内存与存储报告应从供给短缺切换到周期均值回归风险。在检验需求确认这条腿时，买方的成本归因应重于供应商的说法：超大规模厂商把内存涨价计入自身资本计划，是卖方评论无法替代的价格确认。但要对称地读——一个能把内存单列为独立成本冲击的买方，同时具备二次采购、重新议价并将其政治化的信息与动机，因此同一份披露在确认当下定价的同时，也标记了反制的起点。
then.en: then memory and storage coverage should pivot from shortage upside to cyclical mean-reversion risk. Weigh buyer-side cost attribution above supplier claims when testing the demand-confirmation leg: a hyperscaler booking a memory price increase into its own capital plan concedes the price in a way a seller's commentary cannot. Read it symmetrically, though — a buyer able to itemise memory as a discrete cost shock has both the information and the incentive to second-source, renegotiate and politicise it, so the same disclosure that confirms today's pricing also dates the start of the pushback.

if.zh: 如果 CoreWeave 的 backlog、资本开支、租赁和融资成本同时恶化
if.en: If CoreWeave's backlog, capex, leases, and financing cost deteriorate together

then.zh: 则整本 AI 基建书要提高对循环融资和真实需求不足的权重。
then.en: then the whole AI-infra book should raise the weight on circular financing and insufficient real demand.

if.zh: 如果铜、钨、电网设备或本地电力约束继续收紧
if.en: If copper, tungsten, grid equipment, or local power constraints keep tightening

then.zh: 则数据中心扩张上限可能先被资源和施工约束决定，而不是由芯片供给决定。
then.en: then data-center expansion may be capped first by resources and construction constraints, not chip supply.

if.zh: 如果数据中心租赁/backlog 增长，但 interconnection、MRR/cabinet yield 或 xScale/retail colocation 指标没有同步改善
if.en: If data-center leasing/backlog grows but interconnection, MRR/cabinet yield, or xScale/retail colocation metrics do not improve with it

then.zh: 则优先把需求解释为 hyperscale shell / powered-land 集中，而不是广泛的网络密集型 AI 部署。
then.en: then first read demand as hyperscale shell / powered-land concentration, not broad network-dense AI deployment.

if.zh: 如果超大规模厂商从净买入算力转为对外出售或转租算力
if.en: If a hyperscaler flips from net buyer of compute to selling or re-renting capacity externally

then.zh: 则优先重估算力供给紧张假设和 GPU 云的定价权，而不是把新增供给当作需求证据。
then.en: then re-test the compute-scarcity assumption and GPU-cloud pricing power first, rather than reading new supply as demand evidence.

if.zh: 如果 foundry、memory 或 custom silicon capex 继续上修，但 EUV、刻蚀/沉积、过程控制和 EDA/IP backlog 没有同步确认
if.en: If foundry, memory, or custom-silicon capex keeps rising but EUV, etch/deposition, process control, and EDA/IP backlog do not confirm

then.zh: 则应把下游 capex 视为宣布或预算中的产能，而不是已承诺、可制造、可设计完成的 AI 供给。
then.en: then treat downstream capex as announced or budgeted capacity, not committed, manufacturable, design-complete AI supply.

retirementNote.zh: 该规则把先进封装层误当成可直接观测的独立约束；Amkor 覆盖证明本层当前只能给出归属读数，旧规则与历史信号保留用于审计。
retirementNote.en: This rule treated advanced packaging as a directly observable standalone constraint. Amkor coverage showed that the layer currently yields an ownership reading instead; the retired rule and its historical signals remain for auditability.

if.zh: 如果 TSM/HBM/ASIC 需求强劲，但 OSAT、先进封装或基板产能没有同步确认
if.en: If TSM/HBM/ASIC demand stays strong but OSAT, advanced-packaging, or substrate capacity does not confirm it

then.zh: 则 AI 芯片交付瓶颈可能在后端封装而非晶圆或设计端，需要下修可交付供给节奏。
then.en: then the AI-chip delivery bottleneck may sit in back-end packaging rather than wafers or design, and deliverable supply cadence should be marked down.

if.zh: 如果 TSM/HBM/ASIC 需求强劲，但第三方 OSAT 的先进封装份额、独立定价能力与自有 CoWoS 级产能没有同步扩大，且晶圆代工厂继续不单独披露封装排产
if.en: If TSM/HBM/ASIC demand stays strong but third-party OSAT advanced-packaging share, standalone pricing power, and self-owned CoWoS-class capacity do not expand with it, while the foundry continues not to disclose packaging bookings separately

then.zh: 则应把先进封装读成绑定在晶圆代工厂内部、随晶圆一并定价的产能，而不是一个可独立定价的第三方环节；本层给出的是归属读数而非约束读数，交付瓶颈的问题要回到 tsmc-2026。只有当某个点名的 AI 加速器项目在台积电之外实现双源封装时，本层才升级为约束读数。
then.en: then read advanced packaging as capacity bundled inside the foundry and priced with the wafer, not as an independently-priceable third-party link; this layer yields an ownership reading rather than a constraint reading, and the delivery-bottleneck question belongs to tsmc-2026. Only a named AI-accelerator program dual-sourcing packaging outside TSMC upgrades this layer to a constraint reading.

if.zh: 如果 GPU、以太网交换和光连接继续扩张，但 PCIe/CXL retimer 与机架互连读数不跟随
if.en: If GPUs, Ethernet switching, and optical connectivity keep expanding but PCIe/CXL retimer and rack-interconnect readings do not follow

then.zh: 则集群扩张可能仍由传统网络/光层吸收，独立互连瓶颈叙事需要降权。
then.en: then cluster expansion may still be absorbed by traditional networking/optical layers, and the standalone interconnect-bottleneck thesis should be discounted.

if.zh: 如果 GEV、VRT、CEG/VST/NRG 的电力需求读数变强，但电网 EPC backlog、输配建设和项目执行没有同步确认
if.en: If GEV, VRT, and CEG/VST/NRG power-demand readings strengthen but grid-EPC backlog, transmission buildout, and project execution do not confirm

then.zh: 则电力瓶颈更可能卡在并网和施工交付，而不是设备订单或发电资产估值本身。
then.en: then the power bottleneck is more likely grid interconnection and construction delivery, not equipment orders or generation-asset valuation alone.

if.zh: 如果基础模型公司的用户、token 与收入快速增长，但毛利率、付费转化和经营现金流没有同步改善
if.en: If foundation-model users, tokens, and revenue grow quickly but gross margin, paid conversion, and operating cash flow do not improve with them

then.zh: 则不能把 token throughput 当作上游 AI 基建回报的高质量确认，应提高推理单位经济、补贴需求与循环融资风险权重。
then.en: then do not treat token throughput as high-quality validation of upstream AI-infrastructure returns; raise the weight on inference unit economics, subsidized demand, and circular funding risk.

if.zh: 如果 AI 基础设施链条的多个层级（光模块、存储、半导体设备、电力、neocloud）在没有各自基本面否定证据的情况下同步大幅重定价
if.en: If multiple layers of the AI-infrastructure chain (optical, memory, semicap, power, neocloud) reprice sharply together without layer-specific fundamental disconfirmation

then.zh: 则应把它当作贴现率/风险偏好层面的共同因子，而不是逐个公司的论点破裂；各报告需要重新锚定估值算术，但不应据此各自翻转立场。
then.en: then treat it as a common discount-rate / risk-appetite factor rather than as per-company thesis breakage; each report needs its valuation arithmetic re-anchored, but stances should not each be flipped on the move alone.
